package.description: A retro TUI Tetris for the Windows console, hand-written in x86-64 assembly.

en-US.description: A retro TUI Tetris for the Windows console, hand-written in x86-64 assembly.
en-US.longDescription: Retro Tetris is a Tetris for the Windows console, hand-written in x86-64 assembly (NASM). It renders on a green-phosphor palette with ANSI escape codes, reads input through the Win32 console API, and links no C runtime.
en-US.name: Retro Tetris
